```python
import os

def block_website(url):
    # Define the IP address of the website using its domain name
    # This requires a DNS lookup which we can do using the socket library
    import socket
    try:
        ip_address = socket.gethostbyname(url)
    except socket.gaierror:
        print(f"Could not resolve {url} to an IP address.")
        return

    # Construct the iptables command to block the website
    command = f"sudo iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -d {ip_address} -j DROP"
    
    # Execute the command
    os.system(command)
    print(f"Access to {url} has been blocked.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage: Block access to www.example.com
    block_website("www.example.com")
```
